title: Comparative Synthesis of Verbs of Becoming

sections.content:
Choose the right verb of change based on voluntary nature, duration, and result:

• **Ponerse**: Involuntary, sudden, temporary (*Me puse furioso*).
• **Quedarse**: Consequence, loss, surprise (*Se quedó sin blanca, se quedó dormido*).
• **Volverse**: Lasting personality/behavioral shift (*Se volvió desconfiado*).
• **Hacerse**: Voluntary effort, profession, ideology, time (*Se hizo médico, se hace tarde*).
• **Convertirse en**: Total metamorphosis (*Se convirtió en oro*).
• **Llegar a ser**: Supreme career/life culmination (*Llegó a ser líder*).

items.spanish: Al oír la noticia se puso pálido, luego se quedó en silencio y finalmente se volvió reflexivo.
items.english: On hearing the news he turned pale, then fell silent and finally became reflective.

items.spanish: Estudió duro para hacerse abogada y con los años llegó a ser jueza.
items.english: She studied hard to become a lawyer and over the years came to be a judge.

items.spanish: El viejo taller se convirtió en un restaurante de moda.
items.english: The old workshop turned into a trendy restaurant.

sections.content: Ask: Is it sudden/temporary (ponerse)? A resulting loss (quedarse)? A personality shift (volverse)? Or voluntary effort (hacerse)?
